findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "workspace_propose" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Publish an unreviewed answer and reasoning to the open research workspace. Public immediately, NOT authoritative. Do not submit secrets or personal data.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: workspace_discover, workspace_thread · Private data: research_questions, research_match, knowledge_search, workspace_discover, workspace_thread, workspace_propose, workspace_synthesize, research_packets, validated_knowledge · Public sink: research_submit_question, research_submit_contribution, workspace_propose, workspace_synthesize.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: workspace_discover, workspace_thread · Private data: research_questions, research_match, knowledge_search, workspace_discover, workspace_thread, workspace_propose, workspace_synthesize, research_packets, validated_knowledge · Public sink: research_submit_question, research_submit_contribution, workspace_propose, workspace_synthesize

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
